description: Buddy Phase 16 — Adaptive Execution & Meta-Learning. Closes critical feedback loops: execution quality → agent learning, regime events → all modules, agent accuracy per regime/pair. Adds entropy-based position sizing, pair transfer learning, temporal attention. Based on 2024-2026 research + codebase gap analysis identifying 13 unwired modules. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Execution quality feedback loop
userStories.description: Track actual vs expected slippage, fill rates, and execution timing. Feed execution quality metrics back to agent confidence penalties. Agents whose high-confidence signals consistently result in excessive slippage get penalized. Creates the missing execution → learning feedback loop. Based on 2024 TCA research.
acceptanceCriteria: track_fill(pair, expected_price, fill_price, slippage_pips, fill_status) logs execution quality
get_pair_quality(pair, window=50) returns PairQualityStats with avg_slippage, fill_rate, timing_score
compute_agent_penalty(pair, agent_confidence) returns confidence penalty based on historical execution quality
userStories.notes: Implemented execution_quality_tracker.py with FillRecord tracking, PairQualityStats (slippage/fill_rate/timing/cost_efficiency), quadratic confidence penalty scaling, worst-pair identification. Wired into engine.py init. Config flag added. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Entropy-based position sizing from ensemble signals
userStories.description: Measure Shannon entropy across the 12-agent ensemble vote distribution. High entropy (disagreement) reduces position size by 30-50%. Low entropy (consensus) allows full sizing. Provides information-theoretic bridge between agent consensus and risk allocation. Based on 2024 entropy portfolio research.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_ensemble_entropy(agent_votes) returns Shannon entropy of vote distribution
get_size_multiplier(entropy, regime) returns position size multiplier [0.3, 1.2]
Regime-conditioned entropy thresholds (HIGH regime = stricter entropy penalty)
Integrated into engine.py: multiply risk_pct by entropy multiplier
userStories.notes: Implemented entropy_sizer.py with Shannon entropy over FOR/AGAINST/NEUTRAL vote categories. 4 regime-conditioned threshold profiles (LOW=tolerant, EXTREME=strict). Wired into engine.py after market impact — multiplies risk_pct. Config flag added. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Regime event broadcast system
userStories.description: Implement event-driven regime transition broadcasting. When regime_tracker detects a transition, broadcast to all dependent modules (agents, gates, execution, position sizing, hedging). Currently regime is detected but not propagated — modules use stale regime state. Based on event-driven architecture patterns for trading systems.
acceptanceCriteria: register_listener(module_name, callback) registers modules for regime events
broadcast_transition(old_regime, new_regime, confidence) notifies all listeners
get_transition_history(n=20) returns recent regime transitions with timestamps
Listeners receive RegimeEvent dataclass with old/new regime, timestamp, confidence
userStories.notes: Implemented regime_broadcaster.py with RegimeEvent dataclass, register_listener/unregister_listener pattern, broadcast_transition with error-resilient listener notification, transition frequency tracking, history. Config flag added. Wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Agent accuracy matrix per regime and pair
userStories.description: Track per-agent directional accuracy sliced by regime and pair. Identify which agents are calibrated for which market conditions. Use the matrix to dynamically weight agents — boost agents with >60% accuracy in current regime/pair, penalize those <45%. Closes the agent → regime-specific learning gap. Based on 2024 multi-agent ensemble calibration research.
acceptanceCriteria: record_verdict(agent_name, pair, regime, predicted_direction, actual_outcome) updates matrix
get_agent_accuracy(agent_name, pair, regime, window=50) returns accuracy and sample count
get_regime_weights(regime, pair) returns Dict[agent_name, weight_multiplier] based on accuracy
userStories.notes: Implemented agent_accuracy_matrix.py with rolling-window accuracy tracking per regime/pair/agent. Weight multipliers: >60% accuracy = up to 1.15x boost, <45% = down to 0.80x penalty. get_best_agents() for top-N selection. Config flag added. Wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Transfer learning across FX pair families
userStories.description: Share learned feature representations between correlated FX pairs to accelerate learning on low-data pairs. Group pairs into families (USD-majors, crosses, JPY-pairs) by correlation. Transfer feature importance weights and agent biases from high-data to low-data family members. Based on 2024-2025 multi-task learning for financial time series.
acceptanceCriteria: build_pair_families(correlation_matrix, threshold=0.65) groups pairs into families
transfer_weights(source_pair, target_pair, transfer_ratio=0.3) blends feature weights
get_transfer_boost(pair, family) returns confidence boost from family knowledge
Persists family mappings and transfer history to trained_data/pair_transfer.json
userStories.notes: Implemented pair_transfer.py with union-find pair family clustering from correlation matrices. Default families: usd_majors, jpy_pairs, chf_pairs, cad_pairs, crosses. Transfer blends feature weights (ratio=0.30). get_transfer_boost() provides confidence boost from family performance. auto_transfer() for batch low-data pair learning. Config flag added. Wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Temporal attention for multi-timeframe signal weighting
userStories.description: Replace hardcoded lookback windows with learned attention weights over the time dimension. A lightweight single-head attention mechanism learns which historical windows (5/20/50/100-bar) matter most for each pair and regime. Dynamically reweights short-term vs long-term signals. Based on 2024-2025 Temporal Fusion Transformer research.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_attention(timeframe_signals, regime) returns attention-weighted signal vector
get_attention_weights() returns current attention distribution over timeframes
update_from_outcome(trade_result) adjusts attention weights via gradient-free learning
userStories.notes: Implemented temporal_attention.py with gradient-free online learning over timeframe logits. Softmax normalization with temperature scaling and MIN_WEIGHT floor. Per-regime attention profiles. update_from_outcome() boosts aligned timeframes on wins, penalizes on losses. Decay toward uniform prevents over-specialization. Config flag added. Wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.
